name: Message an Agent
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Message an Agent node to send a message to an agent from a workflow, then use the agent's reply in the nodes that follow. The agent runs its own reasoning loop, calls its own tools and skills, and returns a response to the workflow

parameters.name: Agent
parameters.description: Select the agent you want to message
options: Production executions use the agent's published version

parameters.name: Message
parameters.description: Enter the message to send to the agent. Write it the way you'd write a request to a person, and use expressions to include data from earlier nodes

parameters.name: Require Specific Output Format
parameters.description: Turn this on when later nodes need a predictable shape instead of free text. The agent then returns an object on the structuredOutput field that matches the schema you define

parameters.name: Enable Streaming
parameters.description: Whether to stream the agent's response as it generates text, instead of waiting for the complete reply. Enabled by default

parameters.name: Invoke Agent
parameters.description: Whether to call the agent once for all input items or once for each input item:
options: Once Per Item: make one agent call for each input item

parameters.name: Session
parameters.description: Sessions let the agent remember earlier messages. Without one, each execution starts a fresh conversation

parameters.name: Allow Agent to Access Other Nodes' Data
parameters.description: Whether to give the agent a tool that reads the execution data of other nodes in the workflow. Turned off by default, which limits the agent to its own input
